summary: Iter81 — validated all 4 fixes for ScoutMePlay: (1) admin send-test endpoint for all 11 email templates (welcome, activation_24h/72h, conv_waiting/discount/discovery, abandoned_checkout, discount_campaign, report_ready, purchase_confirmation, curve_reminder) — 17/17 pytest cases pass incl. auth guard, invalid recipient, unknown template. (2) /sample-report route serves 200; /api/email/click/{id}?u=... 302-redirects safely (rejects open-redirect to evil.example.com — falls back to scoutmeplay.com). (3) PDF text extracted with PyMuPDF contains 'SCOUT'S FIRST IMPRESSION' and NOT 'Parent Summary'. (4) UI: /login + /signup show global Navigation (SCOUTMEPLAY logo, How it works, What's inside, Pricing, LOG IN, GET STARTED, Upload Video), zero Google buttons, no horizontal overflow at 390px. Admin UI Email tab: PromoEmailsAdmin panel (data-testid promo-emails-admin) with promo-test-email-input and all 11 promo-email-test-{key} buttons; clicking 'Send test' with noreply@scoutmeplay.com shows success toast 'Test sent to noreply@scoutmeplay.com — check the inbox'. Admin Growth tab: labels 'Campaign name', 'Discount %', 'Valid for (hours)' visible above campaign-name-input / campaign-percent / campaign-hours-input.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountGateModal.jsx still has a stale docstring/prop referring to Google (`Email+password only, or Google.` on L14 and unused prop `onGoogleRedirect` on L15). Functionality is fine — Google block was removed — but the comment + unused prop should be cleaned up for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Disposable signup user smtest.iter81.pdf_*@example.com + 1 unlocked report seeded in Mongo for PDF generation, deleted in teardown. Send-test emails go to noreply@scoutmeplay.com only (11 messages during run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter81 reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_email_admin.py (11-template send-test parametrized + click-redirect safety) and /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_pdf_rename.py (PyMuPDF text assertion). PDF text is UPPERCASE — use case-insensitive substring match ('scout' + 'first impression'). Email click endpoint path is /api/email/click/{log_id}?u=... and only redirects to scoutmeplay.com / *.emergentagent.com — anything else falls back to https://scoutmeplay.com. Note the sample-report link inside emails is hardcoded to production scoutmeplay.com (by design); in preview the same page is at {preview}/sample-report and returns 200.
